name: qimendunjia
description: Qi Men Dun Jia and Four Pillars charts: calculation engine, REST API and MCP server

scripts.build: npm run build -w @qimendunjia/i18n -w @qimendunjia/plate -w @qimendunjia/geo -w @qimendunjia/core && npm run build -w @qimendunjia/mcp -w @qimendunjia/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @qimendunjia/i18n && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.prepare: npm run build -w @qimendunjia/i18n -w @qimendunjia/plate -w @qimendunjia/geo -w @qimendunjia/core && npm run build -w @qimendunjia/mcp -w @qimendunjia/web
